decisions: Clarify whether the project needs structural packaging design, artwork adaptation or production review for an existing cosmetic packaging concept.
For skincare and beauty products, prepare product dimensions, bottle or jar weight, retail channel, insert needs and surface finish direction.
Avoid unsupported claims about fixed compliance or food-contact suitability; confirm actual product and market requirements first.
